chapter: Funerals, societies and the future of fiddling
title: Will young players take up old-time fiddling
summary: The interviewer asks whether youngsters will play Cage's kind of fiddle music; Cage says not many.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Somebody caught it. Somebody outside? We can turn it off. Somebody caught it. I'll put you on. I'll put you on. One more question. Uh... Do you know if any young kids are going to take up that same color fiddling you play? Do you think any of those kids will ever do the same as you?
